meta.name: AI Reset Tracker
attribution: Claude event catalog adapted from https://claude-resets.com/data/resets.json (with attribution).
Codex announcements curated from https://codex-resets.com/ and @thsottiaux posts; timestamps from announcement times / status IDs.

Not affiliated with Anthropic, OpenAI, or xAI.

definitions.reset: Announcement that flushed usage counters (5-hour and/or weekly).
definitions.policy: Announcement that changed limits without flushing counters; listed but not counted as a reset.
definitions.immediate: Reset applied (or propagating) without requiring the user to redeem a banked credit.
definitions.banked: Credit placed in a reset bank for the user to apply later.
definitions.unknown: Delivery mode unclear from the announcement text.
definitions.competitive_response: Reset timing aligned with a rival lab launch, promo, or banked-credit wave — interpreted as retention pressure, not an official reason.

grok.name: Grok
grok.note: Paid SuperGrok uses an account-specific shared weekly usage pool (Settings → Usage). Free-tier Chat/Voice limits are separate. Unlike Claude/Codex, there is no dense public “miracle reset” log — anticipator leans on sparse announcements + rival pressure.

events.note: After paid-user throttling complaints on image/video/voice, Elon Musk said Grok usage limits will be increased (policy signal; not a counter flush).
Docs: paid plans share one weekly usage pool across Chat, Imagine, Voice, and Build; reset time is account-specific in Settings → Usage. Free-tier Chat/Voice limits reset on their own schedule.
@bot: All SuperGrok and Cursor Pro subscribers now have Grok Bot access. Also resetting weekly usage limits for all users.

Elon Musk announced another free reset on token usage for @Grok / @Bot users (Sep 1, 2026 coverage); redeemable in Settings → Usage without waiting for the weekly clock. Follows an earlier Grok 4.6-era reset ~3 weeks prior.
